spanish: Y la restante desde ella comerán Aarón y sus hijos; ázimos será comido en lugar santo; en el atrio de tienda de reunión la comerán.
grammarChanges: en atrio -> en el atrio (בַּחֲצַר carries the fused article; 'en atrio' left the court indefinite where the Hebrew does not)
lo restante -> la restante (the niphal participle הַנּוֹתֶרֶת is feminine singular and the later pronoun 'la' is feminine; neuter 'lo' did not agree)
readerNote: Changed neuter 'lo restante' to feminine 'la restante' so the substantivized participle agrees with the later feminine pronoun 'la' and with the feminine niphal participle in the source.
